## Purpose and change class

Describe the change and classify it as A (documentation/CI/packaging), B (software behavior without scientific semantics), C (scientific semantics), or D (data/rights boundary). See `GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Verification

- [ ] The complete public test suite passes.
- [ ] `python -m pip check` passes.
- [ ] Public-boundary and Task 5 governance verifiers pass.
- [ ] Added fixtures are synthetic or have a documented rights decision.
- [ ] No external scientific data, private evidence pack, secret, credential, or local path was added.
- [ ] Scientific scope and maturity are not overstated.
- [ ] Dependency and license implications were reviewed.
- [ ] Provenance and AI assistance affecting the contribution are disclosed.

Do not attach patient data, genotype datasets, confidential evidence packs, publisher files, or private scientific datasets to this pull request.
